company.description:
Rev Genomics is a big data company operating in the plant biotechnology space. It provides plant breeders, growers, and retailers with novel molecular and morphological phenotypes to differentiate themselves in high-value markets.

Rev Genomics was founded in 2015 and is based in Oakland, California.

aiResearchSummary.text: Rev Genomics is engaged in plant biotechnology research, focusing on genetic transformation and ploidy stabilization. They explore methods for stabilizing ploidy in plants, including doubling a plant's ploidy and self-fertilizing to achieve desired germline ploidy. Additionally, they develop submersion-free systems for genetically transforming Cannabis sativa, utilizing cotyledon explants and Agrobacterium co-cultivation. These efforts highlight their commitment to advancing plant biotechnology through innovative genetic techniques.
